title: Post-processing agents
intro: Agents rework a document parsed from PDF (or any import) into clean, well-structured markdown before it is saved. Each agent is defined by a name and a prompt.
name: Name
descriptionPlaceholder: Shown when picking an agent on import
promptPlaceholder: You get a datasheet parsed from PDF with lots of noise — rework it into clean markdown, keep all technical values, drop repeated headers and page numbers.
promptHint: Describes what this agent is for. It is added to a fixed method scaffold (orient, clean globally, restructure section by section, preserve content).
empty: No agents yet. Create one to clean up imported documents automatically.
deleteConfirm: Delete this agent? Imports that reference it will fall back to the unprocessed text.
